title: Scotland's all-time top scorers
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals for Scotland in full internationals, to the end of the 2026 World Cup.

notes.Robert Hamilton: The sources differ by a goal for Robert Hamilton (15 or 14), James McFadden (15, 14 or 13) and Mo Johnston (14), so any of the three fills the last two places.
notes.James McFadden: The sources differ by a goal for McFadden (15 on Wikipedia and the SFA's count, 14 on Transfermarkt, 13 on RSSSF), so he shares the last two places with Robert Hamilton and Mo Johnston.
notes.Mo Johnston: Mo Johnston has 14 and shares the last two places with Robert Hamilton and James McFadden, as the sources differ on their totals.
notes.Che Adams: Che Adams is just outside with 13.
notes.John McGinn: John McGinn had 21 at the end of the 2026 World Cup; goals since then don't count here.
notes.Hughie Gallacher: Hughie Gallacher has 24 on Wikipedia and the SFA's count, 23 on RSSSF; 3rd either way.

checks: Wikipedia's records page as it stood on 1 July 2026 (updated after Scotland's last World Cup match, Brazil v Scotland on 24 June 2026; Scotland played no more games before the cut-off), RSSSF (last match included 24 June 2026) and Transfermarkt's match data agree on the top eight apart from Gallacher (24 or 23, 3rd either way). They differ by a goal on Robert Hamilton, James McFadden and Mo Johnston (Wikipedia 15, 15, 14; RSSSF 14, 13, 14; Transfermarkt 15, 14, 14), so places 9 and 10 are a pool of those three.
